```yaml
name: Private Proof Benchmark

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: MetaMask/action-checkout-and-setup@v3
        with:
          is-high-risk-environment: false
          cache-node-modules: true
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm install --save-dev @types/node tsx

      - name: Run Private Proof E2E Benchmark
        run: |
          npm run benchmark:private:e2e

      - name: Setup GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Upload Benchmark Results
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: Private Proof Benchmark
          tool: 'custom'
          output-file-path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/results.json
          gh-pages-branch: gh-pages
          gh-repository: tetsuo-ai/AgenC
          benchmark-data-dir-path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          auto-push: true
          save-data-file: true
          comment-always: true
          summary-always: true
```

name: Private Proof Benchmark

on:

    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: MetaMask/action-checkout-and-setup@v3
        with:
          is-high-risk-environment: false
          cache-node-modules: true
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm install --save-dev @types/node tsx

      - name: Run Private Proof E2E Benchmark
        run: |
          npm run benchmark:private:e2e

      - name: Setup GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5

      - name: Upload Benchmark Results
        uses: benchmark-action/github-action-benchmark@v1
        with:
          name: Private Proof Benchmark
          tool: 'custom'
          output-file-path: benchmarks/private-proof-e2e/results.json
          gh-pages-branch: gh-pages
          gh-repository: tetsuo-ai/AgenC
